en: Black‑and‑white street scene showing a broad urban avenue with horse‑drawn carriages and an early electric or cable streetcar running on tracks down the center. Multi‑story Victorian and late‑19th‑century commercial buildings line both sides of the street; one corner building in the mid‑ground has ornate bay windows and a balustraded roof. Numerous telegraph or power poles with overhead wires run along the sidewalks and across the street. There is a faint border around the picture suggesting a printed postcard or mounted photograph. Some very small, upside‑down writing appears at the bottom edge of the card.
